description: Project foundation and baseline: zero-dependency TypeScript+Node scaffold that builds, tests, and runs offline. Establishes the full SQLite database schema for all 15 entities (Users, Cards, Sets, Inventory, InventoryLots, Listings, Orders, OrderItems, BulkLots, StorageLocations, PriceSnapshots, Sales, Expenses, Scans, ScanResults), the DatabaseSync connection singleton + migration runner, session-based multi-user authentication (register/login/logout with per-user data isolation), the node:http router with middleware (routing, static files, sessions, body parsing, error handling), and the premium SaaS design system (shared HTML layout with the section-4 sidebar navigation: Dashboard, Scan Cards, Inventory, Singles, Bulk, Listings, Orders, Analytics, Pricing, Settings) plus a placeholder Dashboard page. This feature ends with a runnable server whose pages render and whose test suite passes. It is the prerequisite for all others.
steps: CRITICAL ENV: every node/npm/tsc invocation must run in a shell where NODE_OPTIONS is unset (the sandbox sets it to a nonexistent proxy-bootstrap.js that crashes node). Begin scripts/commands accordingly. Do NOT run `npm install` (registry is 403-forbidden) - the project has ZERO dependencies.

Create /projects/sandbox/PSA/package.json with "type":"module", "private":true, no dependencies/devDependencies, and scripts: "build":"tsc -p tsconfig.json", "start":"node --no-warnings dist/main.js", "dev":"node --no-warnings dist/main.js", "seed":"node --no-warnings dist/scripts/seed.js", "test":"tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --no-warnings --test dist". Note: rely on the shell having NODE_OPTIONS unset before `npm run`.

Create /projects/sandbox/PSA/tsconfig.json: compilerOptions target ES2022, module NodeNext, moduleResolution nodenext, rootDir "src", outDir "dist", strict true, skipLibCheck true, types [], esModuleInterop true, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames true, declaration false, sourceMap false; include ["src"]. IMPORTANT: TypeScript 7 requires rootDir be set explicitly. Put scripts/seed.ts under src/scripts/ so it compiles into dist/scripts/ (keeps a single rootDir).
Create .gitignore ignoring: dist/, data/, node_modules/, *.log, .DS_Store. (Keep .agents/ tracked.)
src/config/index.ts: read PORT (default 4000), DB path (default data/pokeops.db), SESSION cookie name, from process.env with defaults. Export a typed config object.

src/db/connection.ts: export a getDb() singleton using `import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'`, opening config.dbPath (ensure the data/ dir exists via node:fs mkdirSync recursive), setting PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and foreign_keys=ON. Export a helper to close.

src/db/schema.ts: export a runMigrations(db) that CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for all 15 entities with proper columns, foreign keys, and indexes. Model per the user spec sections 8, 23, 25, 26, 37. Include: users(id,email,password_hash,password_salt,display_name,created_at, plus settings columns for pricing_mode and cost assumptions or a JSON settings blob column), sets(id,game,name,abbreviation,series,release_date,total_cards), cards(id,game,set_id FK,name,pokemon_name,number,rarity,card_type,language,is_holo,is_reverse_holo,image_url,external_id), inventory(id,user_id FK,card_id FK,condition,quantity,acquisition_cost,market_value,target_price,status,marketplace,sku,storage_location_id FK,date_acquired,date_listed,date_sold,notes,image_url,is_demo,classification,created_at,updated_at), inventory_lots(id,user_id,category,quantity,estimated_value,notes) for aggregate bulk holdings, storage_locations(id,user_id,box,shelf,slot,label), listings(id,user_id,inventory_id FK nullable,bulk_lot_id FK nullable,marketplace,title,description,price,condition,sku,quantity,item_specifics_json,status,shipping_cost,created_at,published_at), bulk_lots(id,user_id,category,card_count,title,description,suggested_price,sku,guarantees_json,status,created_at), price_snapshots(id,card_id FK,source,market_price,low,high,recent_sold_low,recent_sold_high,competition_count,captured_at), orders(id,user_id,marketplace,external_order_id,buyer,sale_price,fees,shipping,net_revenue,status,tracking_number,created_at,shipped_at), order_items(id,order_id FK,inventory_id FK,listing_id FK nullable,card_id FK,quantity,unit_price), sales(id,user_id,order_id FK,inventory_id FK,card_id FK,sale_price,fees,shipping,cost_basis,net_profit,sold_at), expenses(id,user_id,type,description,amount,incurred_at), scans(id,user_id,image_ref,status,detected_count,created_at), scan_results(id,scan_id FK,card_id FK nullable,pokemon_name,card_name,set_name,set_abbreviation,card_number,rarity,card_type,language,is_holo,is_reverse_holo,estimated_condition,confidence,status,crop_ref,raw_json). Add helpful indexes (inventory.user_id+status, cards.set_id, price_snapshots.card_id, orders.user_id+status).

src/util/ids.ts: crypto-based id generator (node:crypto randomUUID) and short id helper; src/util/password.ts: password hashing using node:crypto scryptSync + random salt, and verify function; src/util/session.ts: signed session tokens using crypto.randomBytes + an in-memory session store map (userId lookup) - acceptable for single-process demo; document that a persistent store is a future upgrade.

src/server/router.ts: a minimal method+path router over node:http supporting path params (e.g. /inventory/:id) via a matcher; supports GET/POST and returns handlers a typed context {req,res,params,query,body,session,user}. src/server/middleware/: bodyParser (JSON + urlencoded + multipart placeholder returning raw for now), sessionMiddleware (parse cookie, load user from session store + users table), static file serving from public/ with correct content-types, and an error wrapper that returns styled 404/500 HTML pages.

src/auth: routes for GET /login, POST /login, GET /register, POST /register, POST /logout. On success set session cookie and redirect to /dashboard. Enforce auth on app routes via a requireAuth guard that redirects unauthenticated users to /login. Ensure per-user data isolation is threaded through by always scoping repository queries by user_id (establish the pattern here).

src/views/layout.ts: renderLayout({title,user,activeNav,body}) returning a full HTML document that links /app.css and /app.js, renders the top bar (product name 'PokeOps', user menu/logout) and the left sidebar with the 10 nav items from section 4, marking the active item. Include a mobile-responsive collapsible sidebar. src/views/components/: small helpers (kpiCard, statusBadge, emptyState, table, button, actionCard) returning HTML strings. Escape all interpolated user data via an escapeHtml util (src/util/html.ts) to prevent XSS.

public/app.css: a professional SaaS design system - CSS variables for a refined neutral palette with a subtle Pokemon-inspired accent (a restrained red/blue accent, NOT cartoonish), typography scale, spacing scale, cards, tables, badges, buttons, forms, sidebar/topbar layout, responsive breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile), smooth transitions, good empty states. Aim for premium/minimal per section 31.
public/app.js: vanilla JS utilities - a tiny fetch helper (apiGet/apiPost returning JSON), toast notifications, sidebar toggle for mobile, and a helper to progressively enhance forms. No frameworks.

src/views/pages/dashboard.ts: a placeholder Dashboard page rendering the layout with a heading and empty-state KPI cards (real data wired in FEAT-006). Route GET / redirects to /dashboard when logged in else /login.

src/main.ts: bootstrap - unset-safe entry: create http server, run migrations, register auth routes + dashboard route + static, listen on config.port, log the URL. Ensure a default demo user is NOT auto-created here (seed handles demo data).

src/db/schema.test.ts: node:test verifying runMigrations creates all 15 tables (query sqlite_master) and that inserting a user + card + inventory row with FKs works and enforces foreign_keys. src/util/password.test.ts: verify hash+verify round-trips and rejects wrong password. src/server/router.test.ts: unit-test the route matcher for static and :param routes.
acceptance_criteria: `unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && npm run build` exits 0 with no tsc errors.
`unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && npm test` runs node:test and all cases pass (schema creates 15 tables, password round-trip, router matching).
`unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && npm start` starts the server, logs a localhost URL, and does not crash; the data/ dir and SQLite file are created.

curl of / redirects (302) to /login when unauthenticated; GET /login and GET /register return 200 HTML with the design-system styling; registering then logging in sets a session cookie and GET /dashboard returns 200 HTML showing the sidebar with all 10 nav items.
All 15 entity tables exist with foreign keys and the documented indexes; queries can be scoped by user_id.
No npm dependencies are installed and package.json has empty dependencies/devDependencies.
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && npm run build && npm test
unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && (npm start & sleep 2; curl -s -i localhost:4000/ | head -5; curl -s -i localhost:4000/login | head -5; kill %1)
node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require('node:sqlite')" is not needed; instead confirm via the schema.test.ts that sqlite_master lists all 15 tables.
findings: Foundation complete and verified. Build (tsc) exits 0; 16 node:test cases pass (schema=15 tables + FK enforcement + user_id scoping, password hash/verify round-trip + wrong-password reject, router matchPath/Router.match for static and :param routes). Server verified end-to-end via curl: / -> 302 /login unauth; /login and /register -> 200 styled HTML; register/login set a pokeops_sid session cookie and redirect to /dashboard which returns 200 with all 10 sidebar nav items; wrong password -> 401; unauth /dashboard -> 302; static /app.css served with correct content-type; 404 page works. `npm run seed` creates an idempotent demo user (demo@pokeops.local / pokeops-demo). Zero dependencies/devDependencies. KEY ENV NOTES for later features: (1) must `unset NODE_OPTIONS` before every node/npm/tsc call (sandbox sets it to a nonexistent proxy-bootstrap.js). (2) `node --test <dir>` treats a bare dir as a module and fails; the test script uses the glob "dist/**/*.test.js" instead. (3) No @types/node available - ambient shims for used built-ins live in src/types/node-shims.d.ts; extend it when using new node API surface. (4) node:sqlite is experimental; scripts run node with --no-warnings. Patterns established for reuse: repositories/ (userRepository shows user_id-scoped access), services/interfaces + services/mock (deterministic offline stubs), views/layout.ts (renderLayout + NAV_ITEMS), views/components/index.ts (kpiCard/statusBadge/emptyState/table/button/actionCard), views/pages, server/routes with requireAuth guard, and escapeHtml for all interpolated data.
